title: Comment on PR-034 "End of the page: back to the original fastwork menu (g0.0,…": queue me, iphone

anchor.label: End of the page: back to the original fastwork menu (g0.0, before the GPU step)

messages.text:
The iPhone is yours now: nothing else is queued or running on it, so no wait.
- Open PR-034 on the phone and use its Try-it links (A = today's v14, B = the original end-of-page); they work over Wi-Fi, the cable can stay or go.
- I paused the "re-plug the cable" steps while you have the phone.

What you need to do: try both pages at the end of the page, then accept "g0" or "keep" on PR-034 (or comment); say "phone free" when you are done.

Thanks, the phone is released; no test needs it for about 3 hours.
- The Mac lost the phone link at 17:41Z (cable in, but the phone tools can't reach it); a "re-plug the cable" step will appear, no rush.
- Next for you: rev 2 of this proposal (PR-034: the original end-of-page plus the Join no-lift fix) in about 30 min.

What you need to do: when convenient, unplug and replug the iPhone cable with the phone unlocked.

The iPhone is yours now, no wait: nothing is queued on it and no test needs it for about 2-3 hours.
- Re-plug steps are paused while you have it.
- The original end-of-page proposal (PR-034) rev 2 with the Join no-lift fix is still in its last checks; I will tell you when it is up.

What you need to do: say "phone free" here when you are done.

Rev 2 of this proposal (PR-034) is up: the original end-of-page with your Join fix; you can try it now on the phone.
- The Join waitlist button no longer rises 8 px before it fades (measured 8.00 px before, 0.00 px now, at every width and in Safari); the blur and fade stay as in your accepted earlier choice.
- Everything else matches rev 1 within 1 colour level; above the end it matches today's v14.
- Try-it option g0: A = v14, B = the new build; there is also a screenshot pair of the button as the menu starts to open.

What you need to do: on PR-034, try option g0 at the end of the page, then accept it or comment.

Thanks, the phone is released; re-plug steps are back on.
- No test needs it yet; the next phone use is the timing test of the final g0 build.

What you need to do: decide rev 2 of this proposal (PR-034) (the original end-of-page with the Join fix) when ready.
